overtime_eligibility.title: Employee overtime eligibility

helpCenter.content:
Summary

As per Belgium law, generally, all employees working overtime are entitled to overtime pay, except those who have the responsibility as the 'thinker, planner, executor and controller of the operation of the company (i.e., managerial) and their working hours cannot be limited based on the normal working hours. For more details, please refer to the policy here: Overtime policy for Belgium (updated January 2024).
